title: Potential KeyError for Content-Type header
detail: The code accesses `self.headers["Content-Type"]` without checking if the header is present. If the header is missing, this will raise a KeyError.

title: Potential race condition with `reset()`
detail: Calling `self._parser.reset()` may lead to a race condition if the parser is still in the middle of processing a request or response.

title: Potential blocking call without timeout
detail: The `stream.read()` call may block indefinitely if the stream does not produce data, leading to potential hangs or unresponsive behavior.

title: Potential race condition with `self._reset()`
detail: Calling `self._reset()` immediately after `stream.read()` may lead to a race condition if the stream is still being processed or if the parser is not in a consistent state.
